purpose: Build broader source-verified isolated-fragment supervision and matching512-protein controls, adding short motifs to both corpora.
inputs: All7680new candidates have exact verified source sequence,contiguous complete N/CA/C/O mapping,and cachedCA agreement. Each of four partitions processes its1920new candidates plus128original proteins. Verify cached latent/CA array hashes and frozen source-backbone hashes. Align actual sources to the cachedCA frame using proper FP64rotations; require sourceCA RMSD<=.02A and full encodingRMSE<=.05 for every new candidate. Correspondence failures stop the shard.
conditions: For new proteins create the established20/30/40percent crops at left,center,right, plus exactly20residue crops at left,center,right. Crop before FP64canonicalization and encoding. For the original512proteins copy all original arrays,attributes,and nine conditions exactly, then add the same three short crops. Existing development inputs remain unchanged. Conditions contain only the supplied crop and its amino-acid sequence.
filtering: Retain every candidate and all numerical evidence in the output ledger. A new protein enters training only if its source and fixed-seed AE3decoded full backbone are coarse-valid and decoded properCA RMSD<=1A. Keep rejected cases in a separate group; no replacement or seed retry. Retain all twelve conditions for each qualified new protein, including individually poor fragment roundtrips. Keep all original512proteins. Require>=90percent of the original7680new candidates to qualify, and>=90percent properCA RMSD/dRMS<=.5A separately for the new fractional and all additive short fragment roundtrips. Actual training size is reported, capped at8192.
controls: Use only the qualified exact-length batch16codec. Per shard: four original historical isolated codes within1e-5; the first new protein in each length bucket gets same-input singleton/full-batch parity,encodedmax<=1e-4,decodedCA RMSD<=.01A,lDDT>=.999,and unchanged endpoint decisions. Those four sources also get rigid-pose controls on their center30percent and center20residue crops,coordinate/latentmax<=1e-4. All16controls must pass; all source and latent correspondence checks pass. Existing512inputs must compare bitwise on CPU before assembly.
assembly: Only after all four qualified reports: assemble one broad corpus and one512-protein control corpus with identical added short-condition recipes, and copy the original16development families unchanged into both. No held-out labels enter training. The original64additional development families and locked tests remain excluded.
next: Before training, specify and profile matched continuations from the same6000-update512-protein parent. Broader supervision and short-mask coverage are interventions; do not call corpus-size differences a pure scaling law. Any objective change requires a separately declared matched control.
resources: Four independent oneRTX data jobs,40minutes each,checkpointing every256proteins. Eightown running-plus-pending GPUs maximum. No teacher labeling or model training in this stage.
